values.AssociatedLNGNotes: An EIA Today in Energy article from 2021 says the Acadiana expansion adds takeaway capacity out of the Haynesville Basin and connects it to the Sabine Pass LNG terminal.

verifications.note: EIA article says the Acadiana project connects Haynesville gas to the Sabine Pass LNG terminal

records.researcher_notes: The EIA article names the Acadiana project and the Sabine Pass terminal. A Kinder Morgan earnings release from 2021 also describes capacity for Cheniere's Sabine Pass liquefaction.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: An EIA Today in Energy article from 2021 says the Cameron Extension expansion on Texas Eastern delivers feedgas to the Calcasieu Pass LNG terminal.

verifications.note: EIA article says the Cameron Extension delivers feedgas to Calcasieu Pass LNG

records.researcher_notes: The EIA article names the Cameron Extension Project and the Calcasieu Pass terminal. EIA's pipeline projects list also says it delivers to Calcasieu Pass.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Natural Gas Intelligence article from April 2024 says the Venice Extension expands the Texas Eastern system to serve the Plaquemines LNG export facility.

verifications.note: page says Venice Extension serves the Plaquemines LNG export facility

records.researcher_notes: The article names the Venice Extension and the Plaquemines LNG export facility.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Kinder Morgan press release from July 2023 calls the Eagle Ford project a critical supply link for growth from power generators, industrial customers, and LNG exporters on its Texas pipeline network.

verifications.note: press release names LNG exporters among customers for the Eagle Ford project

records.researcher_notes: The release names LNG exporters as one of three customer groups the project serves. No single terminal is named, so the terminal is left blank.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Pipeline and Gas Journal article from February 2026 says Forza will serve the growing LNG market and connect to Gulf Coast LNG demand centers.

verifications.note: article says Forza serves growing LNG market and Gulf Coast LNG demand centers

records.researcher_notes: The article ties Forza to LNG demand as one of several reasons for the project. No terminal is named, so the terminal is left blank.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Cheniere press release from December 2014 says Kinder Morgan Tejas Pipeline, Kinder Morgan Texas Pipeline, and Tennessee Gas Pipeline signed 15-year firm transportation deals with Corpus Christi Liquefaction. The service was to supply the Corpus Christi LNG export plant.

verifications.note: Release names Kinder Morgan Tejas Pipeline and 15-year firm transportation for Corpus Christi Liquefaction.

records.researcher_notes: The sheet had Wuhu LNG, a terminal in China, which does not fit this Texas line. The tie is a shipper contract on the Tejas system, not a stated delivery from this main line into the terminal, so confidence is medium.

ledger.note: EIA article ties the Acadiana expansion to Sabine Pass LNG.
EIA article says the Cameron Extension delivers feedgas to Calcasieu Pass LNG.
Natural Gas Intelligence ties the Venice Extension to Plaquemines LNG.
Kinder Morgan release names LNG exporters among customers; no terminal named.
Pipeline and Gas Journal ties Forza to LNG demand along the Gulf Coast; no terminal named.

Checked the August 2026 Pipeline and Gas Journal article and EIA's note on the Bull Run extension. They mention Waha takeaway but no LNG tie for this line. The related Forza line is tagged separately.
Kinder Morgan's project page and the newest EIA entry name power and local utilities as demand. Only an older EIA entry from January 2026 listed LNG, with no terminal, so the tie is not firm.

A Cheniere press release from December 2014 names Kinder Morgan Tejas Pipeline among the lines giving Corpus Christi Liquefaction 15-year firm transportation for the LNG export plant. The sheet terminal Wuhu LNG, a Chinese terminal, is replaced.
